## Project Overview
This repository is a TypeScript library that provides decorator- and non-decorator-based validation for classes, intended for use in both Node.js and browser environments [README.md:1-11]. It is published as “class-validator” and described as “Decorator-based property validation for classes.” [package.json]. Internally it integrates validator.js, and exposes core APIs such as validate, validateOrReject, and validateSync from the library’s public entry point [README.md:1-11][src/index.ts:46-60][src/index.ts:79-96][src/index.ts:121-135]. The codebase is organized primarily under src/, with major modules for decorators (e.g., string and number validators), metadata handling, validation execution, and utilities [src/decorator/string/IsEmail.ts:12-14][src/decorator/number/IsPositive.ts:9-11][src/metadata/MetadataStorage.ts:10-157][src/validation/Validator.ts:9-113][src/utils/convert-to-array.util.ts:4-9]. Build targets include multiple module formats (ES2015, ES5, CommonJS, UMD) and TypeScript declaration output [package.json][tsconfig.prod.esm2015.json:1-5][tsconfig.prod.esm5.json:1-7][tsconfig.prod.cjs.json:1-5][tsconfig.prod.types.json:1-5].

## Setup / Installation
- Installing the library for use in your project: run npm install --save class-validator (the docs also note to use npm@6 or newer due to flattening) [README.md:45-52]. The docs additionally show installation from the next tag if needed [docs/introduction/installation.md:13-21].
- Repository development dependencies are installed with npm; CI uses npm ci to install packages before running checks, which you can also use locally [.github/workflows/continuous-integration-workflow.yml:12-20].
- Node.js is the required runtime; CI config sets up Node “lts/*” (and also tests against “current”), which is a good baseline for local development [.github/workflows/continuous-integration-workflow.yml:7-15][.github/workflows/continuous-integration-workflow.yml:18-24].
- Linting and formatting are configured via ESLint and Prettier; the ESLint config enables TypeScript/Jest plugins and Prettier integration [package.json][.eslintrc.yml][.prettierrc.yml].
- No project-specific environment variables are documented for local development; CI/CD workflows pass registry tokens only for publishing and Codecov upload in the GitHub actions context [.github/workflows/continuous-deployment-workflow.yml:1-29][.github/workflows/continuous-integration-workflow.yml:25-37].

## Running Locally
- Install dependencies: npm ci (as used in CI) [.github/workflows/continuous-integration-workflow.yml:12-20].
- Code quality:
  - Check formatting: npm run prettier:check [package.json].
  - Auto-format: npm run prettier:fix [package.json].
  - Lint: npm run lint:check (or npm run lint:fix) [package.json].
- Build:
  - ES2015: npm run build:es2015 [package.json].
  - ES5: npm run build:esm5 [package.json].
  - CommonJS: npm run build:cjs [package.json].
  - UMD: npm run build:umd [package.json].
  - Types: npm run build:types [package.json].
  - Clean: npm run build:clean [package.json].
  Outputs correspond to tsconfig.prod.* outDir settings (e.g., build/esm2015, build/esm5, build/cjs, build/types) [tsconfig.prod.esm2015.json:1-5][tsconfig.prod.esm5.json:1-7][tsconfig.prod.cjs.json:1-5][tsconfig.prod.types.json:1-5].
- Tests:
  - Run once: npm run test [package.json].
  - Watch mode: npm run test:watch [package.json].
  - CI mode with serial execution and coverage: npm run test:ci [package.json].
- There is no development server and no exposed HTTP port; this is a library build and test workflow [package.json].

## Project Structure
- src/ is the main code folder:
  - Entry point re-exports primary APIs like validate, validateOrReject, validateSync, and registerSchema [src/index.ts:46-60][src/index.ts:79-96][src/index.ts:121-135][src/index.ts:140-142].
  - Decorators implement validation rules (e.g., string, number, date, array, object, and common helpers) [src/decorator/string/IsEmail.ts:12-14][src/decorator/number/IsPositive.ts:9-11][src/decorator/date/MinDate.ts:9-11][src/decorator/array/ArrayMinSize.ts:10-12][src/decorator/object/IsInstance.ts:9-13][src/decorator/common/ValidateBy.ts:23-34].
  - Validation core includes Validator, ValidationExecutor, and types/options/errors [src/validation/Validator.ts:9-113][src/validation/ValidationExecutor.ts:15-37][src/validation/ValidatorOptions.ts:4-89][src/validation/ValidationError.ts:4-49].
  - Metadata subsystem stores and retrieves decorator metadata for execution [src/metadata/MetadataStorage.ts:10-157][src/metadata/ValidationMetadata.ts:7-98].
  - Utilities provide helpers (e.g., global detection, promise detection, collection conversion) [src/utils/get-global.util.ts:7-31][src/utils/is-promise.util.ts:3-5][src/utils/convert-to-array.util.ts:4-9].
- TypeScript configuration targets ES2018, enables decorators/metadata, and emits to build/node for the default tsconfig; production configs specialize module/targets and output directories [tsconfig.json][tsconfig.prod.json:1-5][tsconfig.prod.esm2015.json:1-5][tsconfig.prod.esm5.json:1-7][tsconfig.prod.cjs.json:1-5][tsconfig.prod.types.json:1-5].
- Tests live under test/ (functional tests) and TypeScript compilation excludes test/** and *.spec.ts by default [test/functional/conditional-validation.spec.ts:6-95][test/functional/nested-validation.spec.ts:7-335][tsconfig.json].
- Documentation exists under docs/ with a GitBook configuration pointing to docs as the root and a summary table of contents for guides and references [docs/README.md:1-38][.gitbook.yaml:1-4].
- Repository metadata and automation:
  - ESLint and Prettier configs define code style and rules [.eslintrc.yml][.prettierrc.yml].
  - CI/CD workflows for linting, testing, building, and publishing to npm [.github/workflows/continuous-integration-workflow.yml:1-52][.github/workflows/continuous-deployment-workflow.yml:1-29].

## Testing
- Framework and tooling:
  - Jest configured via ts-jest preset, Node test environment, and coverage collection from src/**/*.ts (excluding index.ts and *.interface.ts) [jest.config.js].
  - ts-jest uses tsconfig.spec.json for test compilation settings [jest.config.js][tsconfig.spec.json].
- Commands:
  - Run tests with coverage: npm run test [package.json].
  - Watch mode: npm run test:watch [package.json].
  - CI-friendly run: npm run test:ci (serial, no cache, coverage, verbose) [package.json].
- Coverage and reporting:
  - CI runs tests on Node LTS and current, uploads coverage to Codecov; coverage files and directories are specified for the uploader and in codecov.yml [.github/workflows/continuous-integration-workflow.yml:18-37][codecov.yml:1-14].
- Test locations and patterns:
  - Functional tests reside under test/functional (e.g., conditional-validation, nested-validation, promise-validation, custom-decorators) [test/functional/conditional-validation.spec.ts:6-95][test/functional/nested-validation.spec.ts:7-335][test/functional/promise-validation.spec.ts:7-155][test/functional/custom-decorators.spec.ts:10-106].
  - TypeScript unit tests for utilities are also present (e.g., convertToArray) [test/utils.spec.ts:3-33].
  - Production TypeScript builds exclude test/** and *.spec.ts from compilation, keeping tests separate from build artifacts [tsconfig.json].
